sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.
Sri Ehtesham Akhtar, Advocate has filed his vakalatnama on behalf of informant.
The same is taken on record.
2. Copy of the statement of victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. produced by learned A.G.A. is taken on record.

3. Heard Sri Virendra Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Shivendra Singh Bhadauria, counsel for the applicant, counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. and perused the material placed on record.
4.
This application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 176 of 2024, under section 376, 323, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Brahampuri, District Meerut.

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant and the victim were in consensual relationship for almost three years.

The consensual relationship that continued between the parties for quite a long time could not be said to have continued under the 'misconception of fact' under Section 90 I.P.C. and could not be said to be 'rape' under Section 375 I.P.C.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
It is next submitted that the investigation is going on and the applicant has apprehension of his arrest in the above mentioned case.
6. Learned A.G.A. and counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
7. Learned counsel for the applicant states that the application for grant of anticipatory bail be confined only till the submission of police report.

8. Having regard to the submissions made by counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail till the submission of police report.
10. In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.

11. The Investigating Officer is directed to conclude the investigation of the present case in accordance with law expeditiously preferably within a period of three months from the date of production of a copy of this order independently without being prejudiced by any observation made by this Court while considering and deciding the present anticipatory bail application of the applicant.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant and the victim were in consensual relationship for almost three years.
The consensual relationship that continued between the parties for quite a long time could not be said to have continued under the 'misconception of fact' under Section 90 I.P.C. and could not be said to be 'rape' under Section 375 I.P.C.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
6. Learned A.G.A. and counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

opennyai_summary.decision:
8. Having regard to the submissions made by counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail till the submission of police report.
9. In the event of arrest, the applicant Shivam Kaushik be released on anticipatory bail in the aforesaid case crime till the submission of police report, if any, under section 173 (2) Cr.P.C., on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) the applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
(iii) the applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
10. In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
11. The Investigating Officer is directed to conclude the investigation of the present case in accordance with law expeditiously preferably within a period of three months from the date of production of a copy of this order independently without being prejudiced by any observation made by this Court while considering and deciding the present anticipatory bail application of the applicant.
The applicant is directed to produce a certified copy of this order, before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned within ten days from today, who shall ensure the compliance of present order.
13. The application stands disposed of.
